label: Bible Study
prompt: I am the true _____, and my Father is the husbandman.
verse: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
note: One of Jesus' 'I am' sayings — with the Father as the husbandman tending the vineyard.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Continue in _____, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verse: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
note: Paul's advice: keep praying, stay watchful, and season it all with thanksgiving.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will _____ bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verse: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
note: God promises to 'rain bread from heaven' — the first announcement of manna.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For a just man falleth _____ times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verse: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
note: The righteous fall too — the difference is they keep getting back up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be _____.
verse: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
note: 'Hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast' — a shelter-in-place word for storms.
